##### Project general facts

Azizi Shaista is a residential development that combines the comforts of home with the vibrant community spirit, offering a choice of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments designed to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Each unit is thoughtfully crafted to optimize space utilization and offer a modern and stylish living experience, whether a cozy studio or a spacious two-bedroom apartment. The interiors provide residents with a comfortable living space that they can truly call home, surrounded by the vibrancy of the community.

The development offers a range of amenities and facilities for residents to enjoy, including a fitness center, swimming pool, and landscaped gardens that provide opportunities for relaxation and leisure. Dedicated parking spaces ensure convenience for all residents, while the well-designed community spaces promote an active and fulfilling lifestyle. These facilities create opportunities for maintaining an active lifestyle within the comfort of the community.

Each residence features high-quality materials and premium appliances and bathroom fittings, creating living spaces that exude contemporary elegance and functionality. The thoughtfully designed interiors provide maximum comfort and convenience, ensuring a stylish and inviting home environment. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious living space that residents are proud to call home.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Al Furjan, a modern and vibrant residential community that offers a high standard of living and a range of amenities for its residents. The community is conveniently located near major highways such as Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The area's strategic positioning near the Jebel Ali Free Zone and the Dubai Expo site makes it an ideal choice for professionals and families alike.

The community is designed to provide a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle, with a range of amenities including parks, community centers, swimming pools, and sports courts. One of the unique features of the area is its emphasis on green spaces, with parks and landscaped areas spread throughout the community. Residents can enjoy a tranquil environment that promotes well-being and outdoor recreation.

The neighborhood offers convenient access to retail outlets and restaurants located within the community, providing residents with easy access to shopping and dining options. The well-planned infrastructure ensures that everything needed for daily life is close at hand. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of modern convenience, green living, and community connectivity, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most desirable residential communities.
